remarks:
Secluded and beautifully maintained home set on nearly 6 acres, surrounded on three sides by over 1,400 acres of state land and just minutes from Rushford Lake. This private, year-round property offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and outdoor recreation.  The home features a spacious layout with a large living room and dining area, two bedrooms, a dry basement, and a screened-in porch—ideal for relaxing or entertaining. A brand-new 35'x35' addition provides incredible extra living space and flexibility. Kitchen appliances that are being included in the sale are the washer, dryer, electric stove, microwave and 2 refrigerators. 
Recent updates include newer cabinetry, updated countertops, a backup furnace, and an iron filtration system. Water is tested annually for added peace of mind. The property includes a small pond, two sheds full of equipment, and is being offered as a true turnkey opportunity with furnishings and equipment included. A rare find for those seeking privacy, nature, and convenience. Propane was just, filled and will be prorated at the time of sale
